verdict.line: You lose when Shadow Dash taunts you mid-cast and bleeds you out in a forced auto-trade; you win if you bait that dash down first and then commit Q from a blind angle.

brief.thesis: The lane is rated even, but the 32.4% win rate over 102 games says otherwise — Shen's E (Shadow Dash) taunts on contact, which locks Sion out of casting anything (including a mid-animation Q) and forces him into pure autos while Shen chooses the follow-up. Sion also starts W (Death's Caress) at level 1 in the common build, meaning he has no Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun until level 2, so Shen gets a free window to poke with Q (Vorpal Blade) from 475 range before Sion can threaten back.

theirWindow.what: Shen can dash 575 range onto you the instant you start casting Q (Cryptic Gaze); the taunt interrupts the cast and locks you into auto-attacking him for its duration. Don't commit Q in the open while this is up — he will punish the cast time.

yourWindow.what: Shadow Dash goes on a full 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown depending on rank. The moment it's down, step up and land Q (Cryptic Gaze) freely, or cast it from inside brush so he physically can't react in time even if the dash is up.

runes.keystoneWhy: The most common page (30.1% pick, 40.5% win rate) — Grasp's proc sustains you through Shen's early poke window and scales naturally with the max HP your E permanently adds on kills.

summoners.why: This pairing is run in 85.3% of games at this matchup (34.6% win rate) — Teleport lets you reset after losing the early skirmish window and still scale into your stronger mid-late game, while Flash gives you an out from the Shadow Dash taunt-lock or a way to force your own Q stun.

playing.title: Never cast Q in the open vs ready E
playing.detail: If Shadow Dash is up, Shen can interrupt your Q cast with the taunt before it lands. Only commit Q from brush or once you've confirmed his E is on cooldown.

playing.title: Lead with W, not E, early
playing.detail: The common build takes W (Death's Caress) at level 1, so you have no Q stun until level 2. Use the shield defensively to soak his Vorpal Blade poke rather than trading with Enrage.

playing.title: Don't toggle Enrage into dash range
playing.detail: E drains your health per attack and taunt locks out ability casts — if Shen taunts you while Enrage is already active, you keep bleeding health through forced autos with no way to turn it off.

playing.title: Detonate W on his commitment
playing.detail: If Shen walks up to auto or cast Vorpal Blade, pop your W shield early to burst him with the explosion instead of waiting passively for it to pop.

playing.title: Save all-ins for level 6+
playing.detail: Cannibalism's leech and attack speed turn even skirmishes in your favor; before 6, you're giving up the solo-kill edge the data already shows Shen has.

playing.title: Punish his Shadow Dash cooldown directly
playing.detail: After he dashes (gank, poke, or missed taunt), his 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown is a hard window — walk up and force a trade or stun-kill a wave instantly with Q.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not early dominance
playing.detail: With a 32.4% recorded win rate, don't force early 1v1s. Farm behind your shield, let E stack permanent max HP off minions, and let Heartsteel/Hollow Radiance carry you into the levels where you're ahead.

brief.patchCaveat: All build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why the taunt interrupt matters, which level breakpoints favor which side, and how to play around Shadow Dash's cooldown — is our own tactical read, not measured data.
